name: Deepdrill Gemm
bio: Gemm is a very popular inventor, famous for using rune magic and diamonds in mining techniques. She’s also famous for her prickly temper and her many, many legal disputes. Disputes often resolved in the ring of honor. With her drills. As far as Gemm is concerned, patent law is a spectator sport.
